clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Reinach / Aesch / Therwil  -  Basel-Landschaft

**Research cutoff: 4 November 2026.**

This corridor has established analytical and bioanalytical laboratories in Reinach, an oral-solid pharmaceutical packaging and warehousing facility in Aesch, and respiratory-device manufacturing in Therwil. Reinach also has two directly advertised property/operator propositions: TechCenter Reinach and iCITY Reinach. These are not evidence of a single life-science campus, a regional vacancy rate, or an aggregate leased footprint. Current operator websites support the presence and offers described below; they do not provide a complete rent roll or proof of all building occupations. [RA01] [RA02] [RA03] [RA04] [RA05] [RA06] [RA07]

Reinach, Aesch and Therwil are listed by the canton as Basel-Landschaft municipalities. Dornach and Witterswil are outside this BL inventory: the official Solothurn municipality register lists both in its Dorneck district, in the version effective 1 January 2026. Do not place nearby Solothurn technology parks into the BL pipeline. [RA15] [RA16]

## Occupier inventory

### Intertek  -  analytical laboratory, Reinach

Intertek (Schweiz) AG directly describes its Reinach analytical laboratory as providing pharmaceutical and medical-device testing, chemical and polymer analysis, extractables and leachables, analytical method development and validation, stability studies, and release/QC testing. It reports a **2,200 m² Swiss testing laboratory**, with Reinach as the scope. The page does not define a gross/net measurement standard, or say that this is the total company lease including offices and ancillary accommodation. Publication date is unknown; the claim was observed on 4 November 2026 and is primary company-reported, not independently measured. [RA03]

The same page says the laboratory meets GLP requirements, is on the WHO list of prequalified QC laboratories, holds GMP certification, has ISO certification for specified methods and has been FDA inspected. These are company statements about the test facility, not evidence of a ready-to-let GMP production suite or quantified utility capacity. Obtain the current certificates and their scope before relying on them in underwriting. [RA03]

There is a material address conflict. The global analytical-lab page publishes **TechCenter Reinach, Kägenstrasse 15, CH-4153 Reinach**. Intertek's Swiss legal notice publishes **TechCenter Reinach, Kägenstraße 18, CH-4153 Reinach**. Both source addresses are retained. They must not be silently harmonized, treated as two separate occupied laboratories, or used to create a definitive roof/parcel pin. Ask Intertek to confirm the laboratory entrance, legal correspondence address, building identifier and occupied demises. [RA03] [RA08]

### Swiss BioQuant  -  bioanalytical CRO, Reinach

Swiss BioQuant AG publishes **Kägenstrasse 18, 4153 Reinach** on its own location page. Its services include LC-MS/MS and ligand-binding assay method development, validation and sample analysis for small and large molecules in non-clinical and clinical studies, plus qPCR bioanalysis for cell and gene therapies. It describes a GLP-compliant test facility and bioanalytical regulatory documentation. This establishes a functioning contract research operation, not therapeutic manufacturing. TechCenter also explicitly identifies Swiss BioQuant among its on-site businesses. [RA04] [RA09] [RA02]

No current primary source reviewed discloses Swiss BioQuant's occupied area, floor, suite, ownership interest, lease expiry, rent or local employment. Do not allocate TechCenter's usable-space total to this company. Its company and site IDs are null in this canton supplement because no matching V6 master profile was identified.

### Thermo Fisher Scientific / Life Technologies  -  company-published Reinach address

Thermo Fisher's official locations page publishes **Neuhofstrasse 11, 4153 Reinach, TechCenter**. Its structured geographic label then says “Basel, CH-BS,” which conflicts with the street locality and the official canton municipality register. Retain the source's address text, but classify the physical locality as Reinach, BL; do not inherit the incorrect BS label. The official page is undated and was observed on 4 November 2026. It supports a company-published location, not a specified local production, R&D or warehousing function. [RA10] [RA15]

The existing global company ID **gco_6cf2212dff0779e17130** is retained for Thermo Fisher Scientific. No existing Reinach site ID was found, so siteId remains null. Life Technologies legal-branch attribution, exact local activities and demised space remain confirmation items. iCITY currently publishes the same street address; this is not evidence that Thermo Fisher moved out or that iCITY took over its entire footprint. [RA07] [RA10]

### Acino  -  pharmaceutical packaging and warehousing, Aesch

Acino's own locations page lists **Acino Pharma AG, Pfeffingerring 205, CH-4147 Aesch**. Its manufacturing-site description specifically assigns Aesch to primary and secondary packaging of oral-solid dosage forms and warehousing. The site reports handling high-potency products up to **OEB 3+**, **five packaging lines**, and a high-speed line capable of **500 blisters per minute**. These figures refer to the Aesch facility's company-stated capabilities; their publication date is unknown and they were observed on 4 November 2026. They are not actual throughput, spare capacity, an area measurement or a building-wide certification. The Aesch detail was read in the company's loaded page HTML because static text extraction omitted its interactive country content. [RA05] [RA06]

Acino's site labels the company as part of Arcera. Its pharmaceutical network's bulk-production activities must not all be assigned to Aesch: the local source statement supports packaging and warehousing, not an inference of API synthesis or bulk-tablet manufacturing at this address. Neither corporate parentage nor an acquisition is closure evidence. No reviewed primary source supplies Aesch land or floor area, landlord/title, lease terms, warehouse pallet capacity, vacancies or a sourced 2025/2026 expansion or contraction. [RA05] [RA06]

### Sentec  -  respiratory medical-device manufacturing, Therwil

Sentec directly lists **Therwil, Switzerland  -  Manufacturing Location** and publishes **Ringstrasse 39, CH-4106 Therwil BL** on its contact page. The company describes non-invasive respiratory monitoring and therapeutic products, with research, development and manufacturing performed in-house. Only the manufacturing function is expressly allocated to Therwil on the location list; the broader corporate R&D statement is not a quantified or building-specific Therwil laboratory claim. The about page displays a 17 June 2025 content timestamp and the contact page a 26 August 2026 timestamp; both were observed on 4 November 2026. A page update is not a relocation or expansion event. [RA01] [RA11]

Sentec's worldwide workforce statement is not used as Therwil employment. Occupied floor area, building tenure, lease expiry, rent, local headcount, cleanroom classes, manufacturing line capacity and available accommodation are not disclosed by these pages.

## Campus and building schedule

**TechCenter Reinach** is a mixed-use property proposition with laboratory, office, commercial and storage accommodation. Its own site publishes **TechCenter Reinach AG, Duggingerstrasse 15, CH-4153 Reinach BL**. That is the campus/operator postal reference, not the occupied address of every tenant. The current property description reports **over 25,000 m² of usable space across six floors**. The basis is source-stated usable space, not gross floor area, land area, lab-only inventory or available area; publication date is unknown and observation date is 4 November 2026. No occupied percentage or tenant allocation has been calculated. [RA02] [RA12]

The property site says it was designed and built in **2010**. A project-engineer record describes the historical D/E/F extension: two outer multifunctional buildings with a multi-storey car park between them, and subsequent tenant-specific works including Swiss BioQuant and Intertek. The engineer names TechCenter Reinach AG as the client. It provides no publication date, definitive completion date or separate historic floor-area total. Therefore the extension is historical configuration evidence, not an undated construction pipeline. No historic area is manufactured from construction cost or an aerial footprint. The supplied JLL extracts reviewed do not provide a historical Reinach/Aesch/Therwil property-area benchmark. [RA02] [RA13]

TechCenter's website identifies **Küng Real Estate** as the letting contact. TechCenter Reinach AG is the published property entity and website publisher, but the pages do not independently establish current cadastral ownership or ultimate beneficial ownership. Obtain the land-register extract and letting authority before treating either the publisher or the agent as the landlord. [RA02] [RA12]

**iCITY Reinach** publishes **Neuhofstrasse 11, 4153 Reinach**. Its legal notice identifies **Vebego AG** as the registered company behind iCITY, with a Zurich legal contact; Vebego's Zurich contact is not a BL laboratory site. Its offerings include furnished chemistry laboratories, biology and analytics labs fitted by agreement, custom-equipped labs and whole-floor lab/office combinations. The source expressly distinguishes ready-to-use rooms from shell-and-core/custom fit-out. [RA07] [RA14] [RA17]

iCITY's lab-floor page reports **3.5 m ceiling height** and **400–500 kg/m² floor-load capacity** for the offered lab-floor product. These are operator-advertised specification claims observed on 4 November 2026, with publication date unknown. They are not independently certified capabilities of every room. The private-lab page describes BSL1/BSL2 biology accommodation and optional safety cabinets. Unit-specific permit status, certified load diagrams, clear versus structural height, ventilation rates and utility redundancy still require technical verification. Do not treat images or image-alt descriptions as separate area or capability measurements. [RA17] [RA18]

No source in this review proves whether iCITY's Neuhofstrasse building is legally within the same ownership parcel or property schedule as TechCenter's D/E/F buildings. Preserve the separately published operator offers; do not add overlapping areas or assume a common owner.

## Development pipeline

No dated 2025 or 2026 local delivery, start of construction, corporate relocation, disposal or closure has been established in the reviewed primary sources. This is an evidence gap, not a zero pipeline. TechCenter's existing building history and iCITY's current leasing/custom-fit-out offers are not evidence of new speculative lab construction. Sentec's 2025/2026 page timestamps confirm website content chronology, not footprint actions. [RA01] [RA02] [RA07] [RA11] [RA13]

The next pipeline check should obtain each municipal/cantonal building-permit reference tied to the verified street addresses, including authorized use changes and fit-out works. Seek a landlord-confirmed schedule for any newly proposed accommodation, with building ID, permit status, area basis, expected handover and fit-out responsibility. Until that is available, do not show a deliverable lab pipeline area or date.

## Availability evidence

TechCenter's live operator page lists the following identifiable offers, observed on **4 November 2026**, with publication date unknown. Areas are the advertised rental-unit areas; the page does not specify a measurement standard. Prices are explicitly **average net asking rent in CHF per m² per year, plus VAT**. These are not achieved rents, company leases, lab rents or a vacancy census. [RA19]

- **F.SG.01.** commercial, **93 m²**, **CHF 195/m²/year**.
- **F.U1.01.** storage, **3,115 m²**, **CHF 120/m²/year**.
- **F.U2.01.** storage, **2,238 m²**, **CHF 120/m²/year**.
- **D.02.01.** office, **1,000 m²**, **CHF 225/m²/year**.
- **D.SG.01.** commercial, **739 m²**, **CHF 195/m²/year**.
- **D.U1.01.** storage range **8–121 m²**, **CHF 120/m²/year**; the number and combination of rooms are not stated.

The schedule gives no dated handover, lease term, signed reservation status or confirmation of lab fit-out for these units. It is useful for a direct enquiry about existing commercial/office/storage space, but does not establish immediately operable wet labs. Do not sum the range with the other offers or derive a campus vacancy rate. [RA19]

At iCITY, the primary website advertises currently available lab units, but its unit widget remained at **“Loading…”** after browser rendering and a subsequent check. No unit ID, area, asking rent, quantity or unit-specific handover was recovered. A third-party listing's headline area or rent is not promoted into this inventory. Ask Vebego/iCITY for its dated unit schedule and distinguish private ready-to-use chemistry rooms from biology/analytics fit-out by agreement and whole-floor shell accommodation. [RA07] [RA17] [RA20]

No reviewed primary source establishes tenant or property availability at Acino, Sentec, Swiss BioQuant, Intertek or Thermo Fisher.

## Property due diligence

For **Intertek**, resolve Kägenstrasse 15 versus 18 first, then obtain a demised-area plan and the measurement basis of its reported laboratory area. For **Swiss BioQuant**, obtain its precise building/floor/lease schedule and current GLP scope. For **Thermo Fisher**, confirm whether the published address remains an occupied operating location, the Life Technologies branch identity, local function and relationship to iCITY; do not infer churn from shared addresses.

For **Acino**, request title/lease evidence, packaging/warehouse gross and net areas, GMP/GDP license scope, containment engineering evidence, loading arrangement, cold-chain requirements and any documented expansion permits. Its advertised packaging speed should be tested against product format, operating shifts and validated line capacity, not converted into speculative production forecasts. For **Sentec**, confirm the manufacturing demises and certified manufacturing/environmental specifications before treating the building as transferable medtech production space.

For **TechCenter** and **iCITY**, request a signed rent roll or current unit inventory, owner and authorized agent identification, contractual rent and service-charge components, lease terms/expiries and fit-out/permit responsibilities. Obtain floor plans tied to official building addresses and parcel identifiers. Local FTE, occupied area, tenure and lease expiry remain unknown for the individual occupiers; a campus total, worldwide workforce, company logo or property photo does not resolve them.

Bio-Rad was encountered as a possible legacy Reinach lead. Its current primary immunohematology contact instead identifies **Route du Pra Rond 23, 1785 Cressier FR**, outside the corridor. That does not establish a Reinach site or prove the closure of any historical Reinach operation. The lead is retained as unresolved/excluded, not added as a verified BL occupant. Other TechCenter businesses without source-established life-science activities are not used to pad the life-science inventory. [RA21]

## Submarket aerials

No retained V6 company site or existing Basel aerial unit covers this corridor. The supplement therefore has an empty retained aerial-ID list; no coordinates, street pins or imagery-derived areas are invented. The practical aerial handoff is to geocode the verified company-address observations against the official Swiss address register, validate parcel/building identity, and prepare separate Reinach Kägen/Neuhof, Aesch Pfeffingerring and Therwil Ringstrasse views. Show TechCenter's Duggingerstrasse address as operator/campus orientation only. Hold Intertek's definitive building pin until its address conflict is resolved.

The app and print set should show imagery acquisition vintage where available, retrieval date and attribution separately. Street-level reference points do not prove rooftop occupancy. This research task writes only the named narrative and JSON files; app edits and new aerial production are not represented as completed.

## Evidence gaps

Completeness means all source-supported life-science addresses encountered in the stated sources, not every company in the municipalities. No coverage denominator, full building census or landlord rent roll was supplied. No local university, hospital or public research institution is established at these particular site addresses in the sources reviewed. The supplied dated JLL extracts were reviewed before public property sources; they do not supply corridor-specific historical area, current availability or tenant space. Private originals are not reproduced or bundled.

The JSON preserves the full verified-source address observations, separate campus/operator records, the conflicting Intertek observations, current offer metrics with their bases, unresolved leads and precise next checks. Nulls mean unverified, not zero.

clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Liestal–Sissach, Basel-Landschaft  -  canton detail V1

Liestal has a documented pharmaceutical manufacturing site, a specialty-pharmaceutical company address, an instrument-development headquarters and a hospital clinical-research anchor. This is a dispersed occupier corridor, not a verified multi-tenant laboratory campus. The clearest industrial footprint action is CordenPharma’s renovation of its existing Liestal facility. No source-backed biotechnology, pharmaceutical-manufacturing or laboratory campus in **Sissach itself** was established in the bounded sources reviewed. That is an evidence gap, not a finding that no such businesses exist. [LS01] [LS02] [LS03] [LS05] [LS07] [LS09]

Research cutoff and observation date: 4 November 2026. Liestal and Sissach are in canton BL; Lausen and Itingen are retained as intervening corridor municipalities, without attributed life-science sites. The canton’s municipality list also distinguishes Böckten from Sissach. Bubendorf, Muttenz–Pratteln, the Aargau/Fricktal extension and foreign sites are not merged into this record. [LS15]

## Occupier inventory

### Corden Pharma Switzerland LLC  -  Eichenweg 1, 4410 Liestal

CordenPharma’s live facility directory explicitly identifies **Corden Pharma Switzerland LLC** at Eichenweg 1. It assigns the site API research and development, GMP manufacturing, commercialization and API support, with peptide, lipid and small-molecule platforms. This is a physical operating facility, not the group headquarters address in Basel. [LS01]

The currently linked Liestal facility sheet describes advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs, including small molecules, lipids, GalNAc and carbohydrates. It identifies on-site process and analytical development, quality control, a cGMP kilo laboratory and multipurpose manufacturing. It also describes a solid-state and purification centre of excellence, chromatographic work, lyophilization, hydrogenation and peptide-synthesis techniques. These are **operator-reported process capabilities**, not a building survey or independently checked current licence schedule. [LS02]

The sheet reports reactors of **20–2,500 L** and **27,000 L total reactor capacity**, scoped to Liestal’s stated equipment inventory. These are vessel-volume figures, not annual production output or floor area. The sheet’s publication date is unknown; its filename contains a 23 December 2025 revision indicator and it was linked by the live company directory when observed on 4 November 2026. No current gross building, net laboratory, occupied, leased or available floor area was established. No figure is imputed from manufacturing capability. [LS01] [LS02]

CordenPharma’s 24 October 2025 article says Liestal was “wrapping up” a five-year facility renovation to expand purification and small-scale development capacity. It does not establish a subsequent completion date, added floor area, a new numbered building or additional leased accommodation. Treat the action as a source-dated upgrade of an existing site, with completion and commissioning still to verify. [LS03]

The V6 snapshot has CordenPharma **Colorado**, `gco_70cd08d154f30063bd4f`, and a separate Colorado laboratory observation, `claude_csv:5c6eedfb4fa8:583`. Neither is the Swiss operator. The Liestal operator therefore remains an additional verified-address lead with null company/site master IDs. CordenPharma’s 5 March 2025 release reports Astorg’s ownership of the group following its earlier acquisition; that is corporate-ownership context, not proof of Liestal property ownership or any closure. The property owner, landlord and owned-versus-leased interest are unknown. [LS04]

### Curatis AG / Curatis Holding AG  -  Weierweg 7, 4410 Liestal

The company’s current site gives this address jointly for Curatis Holding AG and Curatis AG. It describes distribution, licensing and promotion of rare-disease and specialty-care medicines, alongside clinical development of its own drug candidates. Retain both disclosed entities at one shared company contact address; do not create two occupied suites or allocate floor space between them. No matching Curatis or Kinarus profile was found in V6, so these remain null-ID address-inventory leads. [LS05] [LS06]

The 21 September 2026 company release confirms continued development and commercial activity. Its manufacturing update says Curatis received API batches and was progressing drug-product technical development. It does **not** identify Liestal as the batch-production plant or a wet-lab location. The Weierweg record supports a pharmaceutical business address, not an on-site GMP plant, warehouse, cleanroom or clinical-study centre. No 2025/2026 office move, lease, expansion or giveback is established by the sources used. [LS16]

Occupied area, landlord, tenure, local employees, rent, expiry, fit-out and availability remain unknown. The exact subsidiary ownership chain should be checked in the current filing before being used for lease-credit attribution; the joint website label alone is not a lease guarantee. [LS05] [LS06]

### Nanosurf AG  -  Gräubernstrasse 12–14, 4410 Liestal

Nanosurf’s official company page identifies this address and its role in developing atomic-force-microscopy instruments for academic research and industrial applications, including life science and materials science. Its location and historical expansion page identify Liestal as the headquarters. This is a scientific-instruments occupier, not a therapeutics developer or a demonstrated GMP medicines plant. The official page states that Nanosurf is part of Lab14 Group; it does not disclose who owns the Liestal real estate. No Nanosurf company/site ID was found in V6. [LS07] [LS08]

The street range must remain intact. The official address register resolves numbers 12 and 14 independently, but neither the company page nor the register allocates functions, tenancy or area between them. The suffix address 12b returned by a broad geocoder query is not assigned to Nanosurf. No Liestal floor area, lease terms, landlord or current availability is established. [LS07] [LS20] [LS21]

The company’s 26 October 2023 cleanroom-assembly expansion was explicitly **in Pratteln**, serving industrial metrology, particularly semiconductor tools. Its cleanroom, low-vibration floor and load-handling statements must not be transplanted into the Liestal headquarters record. The announcement is also historical, not a 2025/2026 Liestal construction or leasing action. [LS08]

## Hospital and research anchors

### Kantonsspital Baselland, Liestal  -  Rheinstrasse 26, 4410 Liestal

KSBL’s oncology-research page supplies the Liestal address and describes current scientific studies within its oncology and haematology centre. Retain it as a **hospital and clinical-research anchor**, separate from commercial companies, a biotech incubator or leasable laboratory stock. The verified address is a campus reference, not the footprint or street number of each research room or future treatment building. [LS09]

On 27 March 2026, the BL government selected continued development of the Liestal and Bruderholz sites over a new hospital at Salina Raurica in Pratteln and referred a financing proposal to the Landrat. Its statement says planned partial new buildings at the two existing sites can be implemented **by 2032**. That is an indicative two-site program horizon from the decision date, not proof of parliamentary funding approval, construction commencement, completed space or a guaranteed Liestal-only delivery date. [LS10]

For pipeline underwriting, obtain the current Landrat decision and the Liestal project’s approved building program, permits, contractor milestones and commissioning plan. No Liestal-specific new gross floor area, construction floor area, research allocation or external letting schedule was established. Canton sponsorship and hospital operation do not, by themselves, establish parcel title. [LS09] [LS10]

## Campus and building schedule

The verified operating-address schedule comprises Eichenweg 1 for CordenPharma, Weierweg 7 for the jointly disclosed Curatis entities, the Gräubernstrasse 12–14 Nanosurf address range, and the KSBL campus reference at Rheinstrasse 26. None has a sourced tenant floor-area figure. Separate building allocations within the manufacturing and hospital campuses remain unresolved. [LS01] [LS05] [LS07] [LS09]

**Hanroareal, Benzburweg 18, 4410 Liestal** is retained only as a commercial-property context and screening lead, not an established life-science campus. Its own current campus page describes the preserved former factory buildings as **about 21,000 m²** and identifies CoOpera Immobilien AG as sole owner of the entire site. The quantity concerns the factory-building aggregate; the page does not specify a gross/net/leasable measurement standard, occupied area, laboratory area or vacancy. It is the current website’s account of an inherited property stock, observed on 4 November 2026, with publication date unknown. No private brochure figure is promoted into current tenancy. [LS11]

The operator’s tenant roster contains a mix of education, engineering, crafts, arts and health-service practices. It does not establish a biotech or GMP occupant from the sources read. Ordinary practices and environmental/building-analysis labels are not automatically life-science laboratories. The wider campus building labels are not converted into occupied-company street pins. [LS12]

## Development pipeline

CordenPharma’s Liestal renovation is a dated existing-facility upgrade, with incremental area and final completion unverified. KSBL’s partial redevelopment is a planned institutional project at its existing campus, with an indicative program horizon and approval/permit gaps. These are different products and should not be aggregated into speculative commercial laboratory supply. [LS03] [LS10]

CordenPharma’s new Swiss peptide campus is explicitly at **GETEC Park, Muttenz**, according to its 5 March 2025 announcement. The same announcement’s first-half **2028** commercial-start expectation belongs to Muttenz, not Liestal. It is retained only as an exclusion and project-identity safeguard; no Muttenz floor area, employment or capacity enters this corridor’s totals. Bachem’s Sisslerfeld project is in Eiken, Aargau, not Sissach, BL, and remains outside this record. [LS04] [LS17]

No source-backed new commercial wet-lab development, laboratory conversion or life-science-campus delivery schedule in Sissach, Lausen or Itingen was established. The supplied Basel property extracts contain no relevant corridor building/area allocation; Basel-city and Allschwil offers are not transferred here.

## Availability evidence

There is no established marketable availability at the documented CordenPharma, Curatis, Nanosurf or KSBL locations. Unknown availability does not mean fully occupied, vacant or zero available area.

Hanro’s own live listing for **unit 56-030 at Benzburweg 18** advertises ground-floor commercial rooms with a mezzanine in the shed roof. It states **from about 427 m²**, **immediate availability**, starting rent **CHF 3,020 per month** plus **CHF 1,140 per month ancillary costs**. These are advertised terms from an undated public operator listing observed on 4 November 2026, not a negotiated lease or an achieved rent. Veriba Immobilien GmbH is the listed letting contact. Do not treat the quoted area as a measured net-lettable figure or calculate a scientific-space rent benchmark from it. [LS13]

No wet-lab, GMP, biological-containment, solvent-exhaust, cleanroom, power, utility-redundancy or permitted-laboratory-use specification accompanies that listing. It is a **general-commercial screening opportunity**, not laboratory-ready availability. Other general-commercial offers on the campus index are not summed as life-science stock or vacancy. Confirm that the offer is still live, its exact demise and its scientific-use feasibility before advancing it. [LS13]

## Property due diligence and evidence gaps

1. **Operating-site property schedules.** Ask CordenPharma, Curatis and Nanosurf for occupied-building schedules, measured gross/net/tenant areas, legal occupier entities and landlord or title documentation. Obtain executed leases, break/expiry dates, options and reinstatement obligations where relevant. None of these is inferred from a website address.
2. **CordenPharma renovation.** Verify completion and qualification of the Liestal purification/development upgrade, its actual area change and the current Swissmedic licence/inspection scope. Confirm site-specific chemical handling, containment and utility requirements from technical documents rather than the group’s technology-platform labels.
3. **KSBL pipeline.** Check financing approval after the March government referral, Liestal permits, project-building identifiers, area program, procurement and commissioning milestones. Keep clinical/research operating space separate from external commercial supply.
4. **Hanro opportunity.** Request a current letting schedule and measured plans from Veriba. Confirm title, lease term and service-charge basis, as well as permitted use, structure, servicing, ventilation and any conversion capex. The published rent and general-commercial floor space do not validate scientific use.
5. **Sissach and intervening municipalities.** Obtain municipality/canton economic-development operator lists, permit-register results and direct operator confirmations. A coverage denominator is unavailable. The Sissach-labelled Zuercher Technik discovery lead resolves on the company’s own page to **Eiweg 1, 4461 Böckten**; it is an industrial-valve/pressure-regulator supplier, not an established Sissach life-science campus, and is excluded from the corridor occupier inventory. [LS14] [LS24]
6. **Workforce and space-demand discipline.** Local employees, occupied area, suite allocation, lease credit and space-demand direction remain unknown unless separately sourced. Business revenue growth, API receipt or a corporate acquisition is not evidence of a local take, closure or giveback.

## Submarket aerials

No Liestal–Sissach unit or matching corridor site was found in the retained Basel aerial site records; the optional `basel_aerial_units_V1.json` was absent. Existing Bubendorf and Muttenz–Pratteln aerial IDs are not repurposed. The companion JSON provides exact-match official Swiss address-reference coordinates for Eichenweg 1, Weierweg 7, Gräubernstrasse 12 and 14, Rheinstrasse 26 and Benzburweg 18. These are mapping reference points, not roof, parcel, lease-demise or occupied-area boundaries. [LS18] [LS19] [LS20] [LS21] [LS22] [LS23]

For downstream app/print work, separate the Liestal pharmaceutical/hospital addresses from the southern instrument/property addresses. No Sissach company marker should be created without a sourced physical operator address. No aerial image or app/master modification is delivered by this research-only record.

## Source and coverage notes
All undated live pages were observed on 4 November 2026. The companion JSON records source visibility, figure basis and observation dates. Supplied Basel extracts were reviewed first; their original private files are neither copied nor linked in this output. The V6 snapshot captured at 12:55:53 UTC on 4 November 2026 and the retained aerial records were used only for identity reconciliation, not as fresh operator proof.

metadata.headline: Operating Allschwil research/equipment-production and dispersed specialized manufacturing/testing corridors, with future offers separated from delivery. 13 distinct current-supported V6 company IDs; operator-only associations and new null-ID leads remain separate.

scope.rule: Only site/municipality-supported physical activity in this canton. No external extension enters canton company, area, workforce, availability or pipeline totals.
scope.countingPolicy: companyIds is the conservative distinct current-supported master-ID set. Primary company/official site evidence supports canton assignment; a precise address/suite is not required. Directory-only operator associations are disclosed separately and excluded from that set. Historical legal addresses, unresolved/conflicting district leads, institutional anchors and planned projects are excluded. A current source-published contact is not a physical inspection or lease-demise measurement.
scope.municipalityRule: All Basel-Landschaft municipalities are in legal scope; named municipalities are evidence coverage, not a complete municipal census. Schweizerhalle is a locality, not a third Muttenz/Pratteln municipality. Dornach and Witterswil are Solothurn and excluded.

headlineReads.text: Allschwil HQ/HORTUS operate. ALL markets future January 2027 shell letting, HOPE is developer-reported construction for 2028, and SCALE remains planned for 2030. Neither the historical brochure nor capacity headline establishes late-2026 vacancy.

Bachem Building K was inaugurated in April 2026 and July reporting confirms actual commercial GMP production, with expansion/ramp-up continuing. CARBOGEN Bubendorf is current highly potent API/ADC manufacture; Aargau projects are external.

Schweizerhalle/Muttenz/Pratteln supports current chemical/API/RNA activity. CordenPharma’s greenfield proposal was reported deferred in April 2026; it is not a confirmed 2028 delivery or a released-parcel offer.

Reinach analytical/bioanalytical activity, Aesch packaging, Therwil medtech and Liestal manufacturing/instrument activity are dispersed sites. iCITY’s loading widget and Intertek’s address conflict require direct schedules; Sissach/Lausen/Itingen remain explicit evidence gaps.

nextChecks.action: Obtain signed/current ALL unit and commissioning schedule, resolve 1,100 versus nearly 1,400 m² ground floor, handover/fit-out split and BIIE move; reconcile HQ 167a–d versus FAQ 170. Validate current HQ/HORTUS offers, not brochure availability.

Confirm Building K phase boundaries and remaining ramp-up, CARBOGEN 145/171/175/unnumbered-extension use, GETEC/CordenPharma direct project and parcel status, and CordenPharma Liestal renovation qualification. Sisslerfeld remains AG.

Resolve Intertek Kägenstrasse 15/18, obtain iCITY/Vebego live units, confirm TechCenter and Ceres manager offers and measurement/rent/service-charge bases. Hanro is general commercial only until permitted scientific use and fit-out are confirmed.

Verify operator-only Allschwil residents individually; resolve Orbis; obtain site/building geometry and retained/new aerials for Muttenz/Pratteln, Reinach/Aesch/Therwil and Liestal. Request evidence for Sissach/Lausen/Itingen and uncaptured BL municipalities, title/tenancy economics and a census denominator.

Keep Basel occupancy unresolved, with no company pin, occupied area, local headcount, or lease assumptions. The official SwissSearchServer query matched the verified Epalinges address at address-point precision [orbis_epalinges_geocode]; that out-of-region point is deliberately not substituted for a Basel site. This is a site-evidence correction, not evidence of market demand, expansion, contraction, or closure.
